faq.q: What is Peacock Bay in GTA 6?
faq.a: Peacock Bay is a neighborhood listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Peacock Bay confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Peacock Bay as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Peacock Bay?
faq.a: The wiki gives 3 details. Place type: neighborhood. Scope: area. Coordinates: not given. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Peacock Bay information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Peacock Bay, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Peacock Bay?
faq.a: Most of it. Peacock Bay rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. The boundary of the area and what is inside it are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Peacock Bay be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of location entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
